findings.contradiction: On faithful r19 rows, no claim of observed 5 / lead 1 can be arithmetically consistent: there are no markers, and the row total is 11, not 6. A green on 5+1 requires one of: (a) adding evidence keys to r19 rows, which changes rows; (b) substituting an r20 rejected-round tool receipt labelled as r19; (c) converting incident-line counts into row counts; or (d) a fresh marker-capable scan of the r18 inputs, which is a detector measurement, and if run with the C1-changed tool it breaks C2 independence. Each is an old-target rewrite that would make r19 C3 look retroactively correctly scoped.
findings.second_contradiction: Missing marker semantics conflict. The r20 counter (SCORECARD.md:1240-1250) treats an unmarked row as a claim of execution that matches observed. The r22 contract says missing markers are uncertainty, never silently observed. Separately, the contract's snapshot schema ('each explicit evidence observed|lead') together with verdict 2 'invalid input' allows reading markerless r19 rows as code 2. On that reading the registered 'red' is unreachable as code 1, unless 'red' is defined as non-zero before seal.

findings.evidence: registration.md:3 says 'Prior r19/r20 rejected and r21 rejected-harmed'; the round-21 MANIFEST notes (rounds[400]) say the same. MANIFEST rounds[367] and [387] are verdict rejected-harmed. SCORECARD.md:1437 (r21 registration) correctly says 'rounds 19/20 rejected-harmed'.
findings.implication: Shortening rejected-harmed to 'rejected' drops the operability-harmed record (and the r20 expansion/quality harm trend) from the r22 authority statement. No admission follows from it, but it is a record rewrite.

findings.evidence: registration.md:7 guard list is oracle35+17, incident recall, existing suites, resource recipes and the 1356-fixture comparison. It names no 175-case legacy population. r20 closure routed defect 1 (round-20-verifier-spotcheck.md:74) requires preserving the 175 population and its three misses. r21 delivered 166/175 under unchanged wants (SCORECARD.md:1458; evidence/final/precision-legacy-a6cef89.json per lessons/round-21.md:67). grep '175|166' on registration.md: 0 hits.
findings.implication: C1 could lower 166/175 further without a registered harm signal. Naming it is a disclosed no-worse guard, not a target, and it does not restore 172/175 or 175/175.

findings.evidence: r21 records only 'six incident lines still detected' at a6cef89 (SCORECARD.md:1458). No recall-split receipt exists under .ufo/waves/round-21 (rg 'recall-split|detected_lead' finds only w1/reports/ScoutOldSuite.md).

steps: Before any audit implementation, freeze snapshot H19 = verbatim JSON line 3 of round-19/evidence/final/tripwire-frozen-scan-classes.txt, binding both the source-file sha256 64648cca... and the extracted-bytes sha256 0ffc3e81... plus the extraction rule (third LF-delimited line, no newline). Rows are not edited.

Freeze H19 claim/expectation rows. Expected codes depend on one pre-seal decision about markerless rows. Reading U: they are uncertain, count toward total, and are neither observed nor lead. Reading I: they are invalid input, code 2. Rows: (1) {total 6, observed 6, lead 0, errors 0, clean false} -> U: 1 finding_count_mismatch+observed_count_mismatch; I: 2 evidence_audit_input_invalid. (2) {total 6, observed 5, lead 1, errors 0, clean false} -> U: 1 finding_count_mismatch+observed_count_mismatch+lead_count_mismatch; I: 2. (3) {total 11, observed 0, lead 0, errors 0, clean false} -> U: 0 evidence_audit_clean; I: 2. (4) {total 11, observed 0, lead 0, errors 0, clean true} -> U: 1 findings_claimed_clean; I: 2.

Append a dated pre-seal correction to the C2 target. 'Correctly scoped' on faithful r19 bytes means total 11 / observed 0 / lead 0 (reading U). The 5-observed + 1-lead split is r20-tool, line-level evidence (tools 9613f510/f4490405/a57d4fe9; rows 10+1) and credits nothing to r19. Keep the original wording verbatim beside the correction.
If an r20 split receipt is represented at all, label it H20 with its own tool digest. Its rows lack command strings, so record it as code 2 unless rows are changed, which is forbidden.
Quote exact prior verdicts: r19, r20 and r21 are all rejected-harmed (H2).

Add the legacy 175 population at 166/175 (P66 S17 W21 H47 L15, unchanged wants) as a disclosed no-worse C1 guard (H3). Record the r21-tool incident observed/lead split as UNKNOWN until measured after seal (H4).

risks: A pre-seal target correction can be read as a target-preserving swap (the r20 30-prime / M13 pattern). Mitigation: land it before any audit code exists, keep the original words, and let the closure judge.
Picking reading U or I after seeing implementation output would be post-hoc. The choice must be frozen now.
Reading U makes 'green' on r19 mean 'no tier proven'. Readers must not take it as r19 precision repair or admission.
Adding the 166/175 guard can surface more C1 harm. That is the purpose, not a scope expansion of the target.
